201:t_021:6.en:
$n
「So that's the Emperor of the $$新地球皇国$$!」

201:t_021:8.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「His name is $$アウストラリス$$... He is the Emperor of the $$新地球皇国$$ and, at the same time, the ruler of the $$サイデリアル$$.」

201:t_021:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「The fact that he went out of his way to show his face means he has taken an interest in you.」

201:t_021:10.en:
$$レド$$
「That man... is the one who rules the $$サイデリアル$$, the greatest power in the galaxy...!」

201:t_022:3.en:
$n
「Without clinging to a convenient hope, and without going reckless in despair...」

201:t_022:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「This is... $n's consciousness... But... it's different from before...」

201:t_022:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I can tell... what you're trying to do, $n...」

201:t_022:7.en:
$n
「This is... what I have to do right now!」

201:t_023:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「With this timing, he can make it!」

201:t_023:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「Take down the Emperor with your own hands!」

201:t_025:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「To think it would knock away $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$'s full power...!」

201:t_025:2.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...A barrier of spirit quanta... It is indeed worthy of being called the power of a god...」

201:t_025:6.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「So you are a cursed being...」

201:t_025:7.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「But why... are you able to move?」

201:t_026:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We're leaving $n's recovery to them!」

201:t_028:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Fools who don't know their place. That's what you get for trying to lay a hand on $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

201:t_028:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I couldn't care less about $$アウストラリス$$, but for lowly Earthlings to lay hands on that thing, blessed by the $$黒い太陽#sol$$, is not something I can allow.」

201:t_028:4.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「There is no need to worry, $$ストラウス$$. More importantly...」

201:t_028:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「To think you took the $$いがみ合う双子$$ to the Third Stage, even if only for a moment... I'll give you credit for that much.」

201:t_028:6.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「But this is good news for us as well.」

201:t_028:7.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「$$ジ・オーバーライザー$$... You will offer up that power to us.」

201:t_029:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「If we stumble here, we'll never take the Imperial Palace!」

201:t_029:2.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, retreat! The operation has failed!」

201:t_031:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You seem to have improved a little within the flow of $$オリジン・ロー$$, $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$.」

201:t_031:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I've heard about you, cursed wanderer.」

201:t_031:4.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「But you may well be happy.」

201:t_031:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「No one can decide another person's happiness. Not even a god.」

201:t_031:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That is why I seek... the road to $$太極$$.」

201:t_032:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「This ship will hold position here! We'll cover our allies' withdrawal!」

201:t_033:0.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Target point reached! What do we do after this, $$ボス$$!?」

201:t_033:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$クォーター$$ will hold position here! Keep firing until you've seen our allies get away!」

201:t_034:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Target point reached! Captain, your orders!」

201:t_034:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「Hold this position and focus on shelling! Hold out at all costs until every allied unit has withdrawn!」

201:t_035:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「There are still units left! We'll hold on here until they've gotten away!」

201:t_100:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Here we come, $$サイデリアル$$! We'll smash your home base and turn this whole thing around in one go!」

201:t_101:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hang in there, Mom, $$サチ子$$, $$しげる$$! $$かおる$$-chan, Miss $$美重子$$, Mr. $$大門$$, $$健一$$, $$アキラ$$! And everyone in class, too!」

201:t_101:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We'll beat the $$サイデリアル$$ here and definitely protect Japan!」

201:t_102:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do it, $$鉄人$$! Our target is the palace where the Emperor is!」

201:t_102:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We stop the Empire here and turn things around!」

201:t_103:0.en:
$$タケル$$
(An overwhelming presence dominating the battlefield... What is this...?)

201:t_103:1.en:
$$タケル$$
(Is there another $$スフィア・リアクター$$ in this imperial capital that we don't know about...!?)

201:t_104:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
(It resembles the ruins on the planet $$クエント$$...)

201:t_105:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(This aggressive pressure... If I stay still, it's as if I'll be pierced through.)

201:t_105:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(Where is that one...? When will that one show up...!?)

201:t_106:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Even if we were lured in, it's still a chance...!」

ジ・オーバーライザー.evidence: 201:t_028:7 - Australis says he will take 'that power' of the Overriser after the Quarreling Twins were brought to the Third Stage; no library or wiki entry found in the repo, rendering is a guess.

健一.evidence: 201:t_101:0 - Watta's call-out list of people back home (classmate); not in glossary sheet.

kept_omissions: 201:t_022:3: no subject for the participial clause (continues t_022:2 'I'm going to do it'); rendered as a continuation of that sentence
201:t_026:0: 彼等 kept as 'them' (presumably Rand/Setsuko and their group, per t_025:8-9)
201:t_028:0: 退いたか, 'They've pulled back' - the Earth forces; scene settles it
201:t_105:1: そいつ kept gender-neutral ('that one'), unknown source of the pressure
uncertain: 201:t_028:7 and t_028:5: ジ・オーバーライザー is not in the glossary; I proposed 'The Overriser' and could not tell whether it is $n's title, the Sphere's Third Stage form, or Genion GAI; 'offer up that power to us' adds the recipient 'us' (Australis/Sidereal) that the Japanese omits
201:t_025:2: 神の力というだけはある - unclear whether Australis praises his own barrier or $n's power; rendered impersonally ('worthy of being called the power of a god')
201:t_027:1: $n's broken 'Ten...shi' (テンシ keyword, Tenshi) written as literal split English because a name token cannot be split
201:t_022:2-3: やるんだ / ヤケになる rendered as $n's resolve ('I'm going to do it' / 'Without ... going reckless in despair')
201:t_023:3: 'he can make it' - subject $n restored from context (Kouji's 'Do it, $n!' follows)
201:t_028:2: アウストラリスはどうでもいい rendered as 'I couldn't care less about Australis'; あれ = Wrath Babylon; used $$黒い太陽#sol$$ (Sol's Black Sun) rather than #aquarion
201:t_033:0: ボス kept as plain 'Boss' (Bobby addressing Jeffrey, not the pilot Boss)
201:t_101:0: かおるちゃん rendered '$$かおる$$-chan' (chan nickname kept), 先生 -> Miss/Mr. per earlier slices; 健一 proposed as new name Kenichi
